description: Publish queue for the on-site social feed (/feed/). A pg_cron job calls the post-social-feed edge function daily at 15:00 UTC (see supabase/social_feed_automation.sql); the function fetches this file from the live site and inserts every pending entry whose post_date (America/New_York) has arrived into public.social_posts, deduped forever by queue id, so stale entries and repeat calls are harmless. A weekly routine refills pending with the coming week's posts drawn from releasing articles, facts that have photos in FACT_IMAGES, and Chronicles. Caption rules match docs/RULES.md and the social voice: hook first, no URLs in the caption (link_url carries the page), 2 to 4 #hashtags at the end, no em or en dashes, US spelling. media_url and link_url are site-relative; the function makes them absolute.

pending.caption: Dex is back. Part 14 of the Chronicles just dropped, and this one is called The Long Drop, which should worry you exactly as much as it worries Dex. Otis has a new episode up too. #chronicles #beardeddragon #petstories

The pygmy marmoset weighs about as much as a stick of butter and is still a full grown monkey. Some of its calls are pitched so high that predators, and you, cannot hear them at all. #pygmymarmoset #monkey #animalfacts

Uromastyx or bearded dragon? Both are chill desert lizards with big personalities, but one eats salad for life and the other needs a bug budget. Full comparison is up now. #uromastyx #beardeddragon #reptiles
Dachshund literally means badger dog in German. The short legs come from a form of dwarfism that was bred in on purpose, ideal for following a badger into its own burrow. #dachshund #dogfacts #dogs

Gerbil vs guinea pig is really a question of space, noise, and how much veggie prep you want in your life. We lined them up side by side so you can pick with your eyes open. #gerbil #guineapig #smallpets

Gerbil or hamster? One is a social sprinter that should live in pairs, the other a solitary night owl that will fight a roommate. The right pick depends on your schedule more than your shelf space. Full comparison now on the site. #gerbil #hamster #smallpets

The pet store starter kit is the expensive way to start a bearded dragon. We put the whole buy once setup in one cart, real prices included, plus the stuff to leave on the shelf. #beardeddragon #reptilecare #petgear

A chinchilla can live 15 years and needs a cool room and regular dust baths. A hamster asks for far less and gives you two or three years. Very different commitments hiding behind similar cages. #chinchilla #hamster #smallpets

Degu vs chinchilla looks like a coin flip until you read their care sheets. One is awake with you all day, the other parties after midnight, and their dust bath routines are not the same. New comparison guide is live. #degu #chinchilla #smallpets

The kea is the world's only alpine parrot and one of the smartest birds alive. It also strips rubber off cars and steals wallets at New Zealand ski resorts. Researchers think all that tinkering is how it learns about its world. #kea #parrot #birdfacts

The Gila monster eats just a few meals a year, and a protein from its venom helped inspire the GLP-1 drugs behind Ozempic. Not bad for a lizard that spends most of its life underground. #gilamonster #reptiles #animalfacts

Koi and goldfish get mixed up constantly, but one outgrows a bathtub and can outlive your dog. Before you stock a pond or a tank, make sure you know which one you are actually buying. #koi #goldfish #fishkeeping
Lovebird or budgie? One talks better, one bonds harder, and the noise levels are not even close. The full comparison is up now. #lovebird #budgie #birds

The barreleye fish has a transparent dome for a head, and its glowing green eyes swivel inside it. Scientists assumed those eyes were stuck looking straight up until a 2009 study caught them rotating forward to track food. #barreleye #deepsea #oceanfacts

Milk snake or corn snake? They get confused for each other and for venomous lookalikes, yet their care, temperament, and handling feel noticeably different once you have both in hand. Full breakdown on the site. #milksnake #cornsnake #reptiles

Tarantula vs emperor scorpion: both look intimidating, both are surprisingly beginner friendly, and the daily care is not what most people expect. We compared them head to head. #tarantula #scorpion #exoticpets
Discus are called the king of the aquarium, and the throne is not cheap. We broke down the real cost of doing discus right, from the tank to the water itself. #discus #aquarium #fishkeeping

A flying squirrel costs less to buy than most people expect. Then the cage, the wheel, and the diet math show up. We priced out the real first year, line by line. #flyingsquirrel #exoticpets #petcosts
Mollies look like the cheapest fish in the store, and the fish is. The setup around it is where the receipt grows. Full first year price breakdown on the site. #molly #aquarium #fishkeeping

The basilisk lizard runs on water. Up to 20 steps per second slap air pockets under its feet, enough to sprint about 20 meters across the surface before it drops back in and swims. #basilisk #lizard #reptilefacts

Cardinal tetras are tiny, but feeding them wrong is the fastest way to lose a school. Portion size, schedule, and what actually fits their mouths, all in the new feeding guide. #cardinaltetra #aquarium #fishkeeping

Feeding a flying squirrel is not just nuts and seeds. Calcium balance is the whole game, and getting it wrong shows up in their bones. The new feeding guide covers the full diet. #flyingsquirrel #exoticpets #petcare
Discus do not want to be handled, they want to be managed. Social structure, stress triggers, and why a calm discus tank is really a well designed one. #discus #aquarium #fishkeeping

You do not grab a flying squirrel. You become the tree. Bonding pouches, glide practice, and the patience curve that turns a nervous squirrel into a shoulder pet. New handling guide is up. #flyingsquirrel #exoticpets #pocketpets
Mollies breed like it is their job, because it is. How to handle them safely and manage the fry wave before your tank becomes a nursery. #molly #fishkeeping #aquarium
